description: One login option on the login page. `local` is this app's own username and password login; every other row is a provider of an OpenG2P IAM service.

fields.description: Sent by the frontend to pick this login: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. `local` is reserved for this app's own login. Cannot change after saving: local users are derived from it.
fields.label: Key

fields.description: A disabled row is hidden from the login page, and its tokens are refused.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Must be a public file: the providers endpoint is public.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: Order of the buttons, lowest first.
fields.label: Sort Order

fields.description: IAM API root as this server reaches it. https, or loopback.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Row id of the provider in that IAM's login_providers table.
fields.label: Provider ID

fields.description: Exact `iss` of tokens from this provider, including scheme and trailing slash. Only tokens whose `iss` matches an enabled row are accepted.
fields.label: Issuer

fields.description: Optional. When set, a token whose `azp` differs is refused.
fields.label: Client ID

fields.description: That IAM's auth_cookie_prefix. Empty means IAM's unprefixed cookie names.
fields.label: Cookie Prefix
Identity provider userinfo
fields.description: Optional. For a provider whose token holds only the subject (eSignet): this server fetches the person's details here after IAM accepts the token.

fields.label: Userinfo URL
fields.description: The provider's userinfo endpoint. https, or loopback. Leave empty to skip.

fields.label: Userinfo Keys URL
fields.description: The provider's JWKS, to verify a signed (JWT) userinfo answer. Leave empty if the provider signs userinfo with a key it does not publish: the answer is then trusted as received over https from the userinfo URL.
Keycloak client id whose roles become Frappe roles (resource_access[application]). A mismatch is silent: tokens validate and carry no roles.
fields.label: Application

fields.description: Frappe roles every user of this login gets, whatever the token says. Granted to anyone the provider authenticates, so keep them low-privilege.
fields.label: Default Roles

fields.description: Frontend origins allowed as return_url when starting this login. Empty refuses every login on this row.
fields.label: Return Origins

name: OAN IAM Service
